_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED BY eggs/generate.py
name: Aoede
author: landonhalley@users.noreply.github.com
description: Aoede is a Discord music bot that streams Spotify directly into a voice channel, controlled entirely from the Spotify app via Spotify Connect. It plays through Spotify Soloist and updates itself from GitHub on every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Aoede install script. Downloads the latest Aoede build; it also updates itself
# on every start, so reinstalling is never needed for updates.
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="${GITHUB_REPO:-landonhalley/aoede}"
BASE_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/latest"
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo "Downloading Aoede from ${REPO}..."
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "${BASE_URL}/aoede-linux-${ARCH}" -o aoede
chmod +x aoede
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "${BASE_URL}/version.txt" -o .aoede-version
mkdir -p data
echo "Aoede installed."

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Token of your Discord bot, from https://discord.com/developers/applications

variables.name: Discord User ID
variables.description: Discord user ID of the person Aoede follows into voice channels. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click your name and choose Copy User ID.

variables.name: Soloist API Key
variables.description: Spotify Soloist API key, generated with a Premium account at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard/soloist

variables.name: Spotify Device Name
variables.description: Name Aoede shows up as in Spotify's device list.

variables.name: Initial Volume
variables.description: Initial Spotify volume from 0 to 100. Leave empty for Soloist's default.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Download the latest Aoede build from GitHub on every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log filter, e.g. 'info' or 'info,songbird=debug' for voice troubleshooting.
